name: Career & Job Search
description: Résumés, cover letters, interviews and professional outreach

prompts.title: Résumé Achievement Bullets
prompts.description: Turn a responsibility into achievement-focused bullet points

variables.name: responsibility
variables.description: What you did in the role
variables.example: Managed the company's social media accounts

variables.name: context
variables.example: Marketing coordinator at a 20-person startup

input.context: Support agent at a SaaS company

examples.output:
• Resolved [add number] customer support tickets per week with a [add %] satisfaction rating, cutting average response time from [X] to [Y].
• Created 12 reusable help-desk macros that reduced repeat questions and onboarded 3 new agents in under a week.

prompts.title: Cover Letter Draft
prompts.description: Draft a tailored cover letter from your background

variables.name: role
variables.example: Product Designer

variables.name: company
variables.example: a sustainability-focused startup

variables.name: background
variables.example: 5 years in UX, led a redesign that lifted retention 18%

variables.name: motivation
variables.example: I want to work on products with environmental impact

prompts.title: Tailor Résumé to a Job
prompts.description: Align your experience to a specific job description
prompts.content:
Compare my experience to the job description below. Output:
1. The 5 most relevant strengths I should emphasise
2. Keywords from the posting I should mirror
3. Honest gaps and how I might address or reframe them

My experience:
{{resume_summary}}

Job description:
{{job_description}}

variables.name: resume_summary
variables.example: Paste your résumé summary or key points

variables.name: job_description
variables.example: Paste the full job description

prompts.title: Interview Prep
prompts.description: Likely questions and strong answer frames for a role
prompts.content:
I'm interviewing for {{role}}. Generate {{count}} likely interview questions (mix of behavioural and role-specific). For each, give a short framework for a strong answer drawing on my background, not a scripted answer.

My background: {{background}}

variables.name: role
variables.example: Senior Project Manager

variables.name: background
variables.example: 7 years managing software projects, PMP certified

prompts.title: STAR Interview Answer
prompts.description: Structure an experience into a Situation-Task-Action-Result answer

variables.name: question
variables.example: Tell me about a time you handled conflict

variables.name: experience
variables.description: The real experience to base it on
variables.example: A disagreement with a designer over a deadline

prompts.title: Networking Outreach
prompts.description: Write a short, genuine outreach message
prompts.content:
Write a {{tone}} outreach message to {{recipient}} with this goal: {{goal}}. Keep it under {{length}}, make it specific to them (not copy-paste), and end with a low-pressure ask.

What I know about them / our connection: {{context}}

variables.name: tone
variables.example: warm and respectful

variables.name: recipient
variables.example: a hiring manager I met at a conference

variables.name: goal
variables.example: a 15-minute chat about the open data role

variables.name: context
variables.description: Your connection or what you know about them
variables.example: We spoke briefly about their migration to the cloud

variables.name: length
variables.example: 100 words

prompts.title: Salary Negotiation Message
prompts.description: Draft a confident, evidence-based negotiation note

variables.name: offer
variables.example: $95k base, no signing bonus

variables.name: market_context
variables.example: comparable roles list $105–120k in this city

variables.name: leverage
variables.example: a competing offer at $110k and a niche skill

prompts.title: Professional Summary / Bio
prompts.description: Write a polished headline and short professional bio
prompts.content: Write a {{tone}} professional summary for a {{role}}, suitable for a résumé top section or a profile "about". Highlight these strengths: {{strengths}}. Provide one ~40-word version and one ~120-word version.

variables.name: tone
variables.example: confident but down-to-earth

variables.name: role
variables.example: full-stack developer

variables.name: strengths
variables.example: shipping fast, mentoring juniors, fintech domain knowledge
